# GitHub Prompts Directory

This directory contains prompt definitions and instructions used for GitHub Copilot and other AI assistants.

## Purpose

- Store standardized prompt templates for consistent AI interactions across the project
- Maintain versioned prompt engineering artifacts
- Provide clear guidelines for how AI tools should interact with this codebase

## Contents

- Prompt templates for different use cases
- System instructions for AI assistants
- Configuration files for AI tooling
